verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dover has outreach Campaigns, per-stage email templates, and AI that generates a careers page from the company website. None of it shows AI drafting job descriptions, outreach sequences, or rejection notes in the recruiter's tone from role context. Those are adjacent features (manual templates and sequences, careers-page generation, interview-question suggestions), not this capability.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI drafts the words — job descriptions, outreach sequences, and rejection notes generated in my tone from the role's context
